summary: Iteration 24: P0 Bug Fixes Testing Complete. Both bugs verified fixed. Bug 1 (Cross-Border Watch): No LOW severity items and no non-Latin (Bengali/Hindi) characters in titles or summaries. Bug 2 (Daily Brief PDF): Key Developments section only contains NER states (Assam, Manipur, Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Mizoram) - no Bangladesh, Myanmar, or empty state items.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 verified two P0 bug fixes: 1) Cross-Border Watch now filters out LOW severity items and non-Latin (Bengali/Hindi/Assamese) characters in titles/summaries via DB query and has_non_latin_chars() check. 2) Daily Brief PDF Key Developments section now only includes NER states (Assam, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Manipur, Arunachal Pradesh, Tripura, Nagaland, Sikkim, Multiple) - Bangladesh, Myanmar, and empty states are excluded.
